title.en: antiques and bric-a-brac at the grand sablon.
title.de: antiquitäten und trödel am grand sablon.
title.tr: grand sablon'da antika ve eski eşya.

line.en: the antiques stalls on place du grand sablon, saturday morning. about forty dealers; the cafés on the square are good for after.
line.de: die antiquitätenstände auf dem place du grand sablon, samstagmorgen. rund vierzig händler; die cafés am platz passen danach.
line.tr: place du grand sablon'daki antika tezgahları, cumartesi sabahı. yaklaşık kırk satıcı; sonrası için meydandaki kafeler uygun.

sparks.why: Sablon antiques market, about 40 dealers, Sat and Sun mornings (markets.brussels.be, as in the 14 Nov entry; weekly schedule, not re-checked for this date).
